description: Cell type described in Feng et al. (2020), nomenclature scheme explained in Ehrhardt et al. (2023).

Unilateral neuron of the LUL152 group of the adult ventral nerve cord that primarily arborizes in the leg neuropil (Feng et al. 2020; Ehrhardt et al., 2023). It is an interneuron that arborizes mainly within one neuromere of the VNC (Feng et al. 2020; Ehrhardt et al., 2023). It has its soma in the prothoracic, mesothoracic or metathoracic neuromere (Feng et al., 2020). There is 1 of these cells per hemineuromere (Feng et al., 2020).
docs.label: adult LUL152 neuron of ventral nerve cord

description: Cell type described in Feng et al. (2020), nomenclature scheme explained in Ehrhardt et al. (2023).

Adult LUL152 neuron with its soma in the prothoracic neuromere (Feng et al., 2020). It is weakly excited downstream of moonwalker descending neuron activity (Feng et al., 2020). There is 1 of these cells per hemineuromere (Feng et al., 2020).

Bilateral neuron of the LBA22 group of the adult ventral nerve cord that primarily arborizes in the leg neuropil (Feng et al. 2020; Ehrhardt et al., 2023). There are 1 or 2 of these cells per hemineuromere (Feng et al., 2020).
